message: I’ve learned the hard way that tech can fail us at the most inconvenient times, so having a fire extinguisher handy feels like a little safety net in my pantry. It’s a small reminder that sometimes, the simplest solutions are the best! 🔥 Do you have any clever safety habits in your home?
scene: a compact fire extinguisher mounted inside a tidy pantry door (just after cleanup, everything tidy)
